# Vendored Fritzing parts (breadboard drawings)

The pictures of the Arduino Nano, the LED, the resistor, the servo, the joystick, the micro-SD module and the Schottky diode used by the wiring diagrams (`docs/hardware/images/wiring/`), generated by
`tools/generators/gen_wiring.py`. Documentation artwork only: **nothing here is compiled into the firmware**.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | <https://github.com/fritzing/fritzing-parts>, commit `27535f2fd02097be9bed229b75aa8e9be282a4a0` (2026-07-23), fetched 2026-10-14 |
| What | `svg/` = the *breadboard* view of seven parts; `fzp/` = their part definitions (the connector names and ids the generator reads) |
| Licence | **Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported** (`LICENSE.txt`, the repository's statement: "All graphics and documentation of Fritzing are licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0") |
| Modifications | **none**: byte-identical to upstream (`sha256sum -c MANIFEST.sha256`). The generator embeds them, scaled, in a larger drawing |
| Authors (from the `.fzp`) | Arduino Nano (Rev3.0): Althaus (2013); Red LED 5 mm and 220 Ω resistor: Brendan Howell (2008, 2009); Basic Servo: Stefan Hermann (2008); Thumb Joystick (SparkFun breakout): SparkFun (2011); MicroSD Card Module: Richard Bruneau and F. Althaus (2015); Schottky Diode 1N5817: André Knörig (2010) |

| Part | `svg/` | `fzp/` |
|---|---|---|
| Arduino Nano (Rev3.0) | `Arduino Nano3_breadboard.svg` | `Arduino Nano3(fix).fzp` |
| Red LED, 5 mm | `LED-5mm-red-leg.svg` | `LED-generic-5mm_6852162_005.fzp` |
| 220 Ω resistor | `resistor_220.svg` | `resistor.fzp` |
| Basic servo (the pen) | `servo.svg` | `servo.fzp` |
| Analog thumb joystick (SparkFun breakout; the module on the machine has the same five functions: GND, +5 V, X, Y, button) | `Joystick-Breakout-v11_breadboard.svg` | `Joystick-Breakout-v11.fzp` |
| MicroSD card module (SPI) | `microsdmodule_breadboard.svg` | `microsdmodule.fzp` |
| Schottky diode 1N5817 (series diode on the Nano's 5V, a proposed variant) | `diode.svg` | `diode_schottky_1N5817_300mil.fzp` |

## What the licence means for this project (decided 2026-10-14)
- **ShareAlike**: a drawing that embeds these parts is an adaptation and must be published under **CC BY-SA 3.0**, not under the GPLv3 of the firmware.
  So every SVG in `docs/hardware/images/wiring/` carries, in its own `<metadata>`, the credit "created with parts from Fritzing (fritzing.org), CC BY-SA 3.0"
  and the licence URL; `docs/hardware/images/wiring/README.md` states the same. The generator that writes them stays GPLv3 (it contains no part of the artwork).
- **Attribution**: the credit above travels with every diagram, and this directory travels with the repository.
- The firmware, the tools and the text documents are not affected.
- Parts that Fritzing's repository does not have (the ULN2003 board with its 28BYJ-48 motor, the 2×16 LCD with its I²C backpack, the external supply) are drawn by the project
  (`tools/generators/gen_wiring.py`, classes `UlnMotor`, `LcdI2c`, `Supply5V`), in the same style; they are the project's own work and follow the licence of the diagram that contains them (CC BY-SA 3.0 as soon as it embeds a Fritzing part).
